epic.title: Lane J -- launcher declared defaults (#619 + #633)
epic.intent_and_why: A launcher must take a declared value, not a machine-local one: the installer must stop rewriting its own checkout's tracked .mcp.json on a run declared elsewhere, and run_crew.py must resolve an unset model from a declared per-role/per-harness tier table instead of any host default.

definition_of_done: A real install with --dest outside the repo leaves the repo's .mcp.json byte-identical
A crew dispatched with no --model runs at its role's table default, proven from the registry entry
A model outside a role's allowed set is refused by name; a non-default in-set choice requires and records a reason
Full suite green on Linux in a clean detached worktree, MapTreeFreshnessTests the only permitted failure

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Each fix test-led, TDD red/green proof reproduced independently by the reviewer
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Full pytest suite plus one real crew dispatch inspected via its registry entry, not the code
good_enough.appetite: One focused session, two bounded changes with clear acceptance tests (per LAUNCH_ORDER Budget)

hard_constraints: No changes to scripts/checklist_engine.py, scripts/mcp_spine_server.py, any *SPINE*.template.json, specs/ -- fenced to lane K
No issue filing mid-run -- stage triage candidates only
fixed_decisions: decision:ship-todays-tiers -- claude harness: admiral opus; commander/implementer/reviewer/critic/cartographer sonnet, haiku allowed below
decision:fail-closed-cheaper -- unset model resolves from role, never host settings
decision:refuse-by-name -- model outside allowed set refused by name
decision:reason-on-deviation -- non-default in-set choice requires --reason, recorded in the registry
decision:harness-dimension-is-required -- table expresses codex/local; harness declared via --command, not detected

current_wave.objective: Ship both fixes with crew-gated implement/review/integrate cycles
exit_criteria: g3 (wired into CrewLaunchSpec.__post_init__, the single choke point) closed complete
g4 (real no-model dispatch proof + full suite in a clean detached worktree) closed complete
